author.name: Linden Street Bakery
author.headline: Neighbourhood bakery · Sourdough, cakes and coffee since 1998

text:
Behind the counter: how the bread gets made.

The starter is fed at 9 every evening, the dough is mixed at 4 and shaped at 5. The first loaves leave the oven at 7, which is why the queue starts at ten to.

Rye takes longest: two days from starter to shelf. Spelt is the quickest, so it sells out first.

Nothing is frozen. What is left at 6 goes to the food bank on Linden Street the same evening.

Questions about a loaf? Ask at the counter, the bakers are happy to explain.

image.alt: A slice of apple crumb cake on a white plate next to a cup of coffee

notes: A long X post about the bread schedule. The first two lines carry it; the rest is for readers who open it.
